name: Landscaping Inbound Calls

hero.headline: Landscaping Inbound Calls
hero.subheadline: Connect with high-intent consumers actively looking for landscaping solutions.

overview: Landscaping Inbound Calls are consumers who see an offer and dial in themselves, generated by Altarious Global performance campaigns and delivered to your business in real time. Reach homeowners seeking landscape design, hardscaping, lawn care and tree services and connect them with local landscaping companies.

Homeowners looking for landscaping help usually want a quick conversation about availability and pricing before they commit to an estimate visit. Inbound Call programs place local landscaping offers in front of homeowners searching for maintenance, tree work or outdoor projects and connect them directly to the company's office. Callers arrive with a specific need, whether that is a storm-damaged tree, a new patio or a season of lawn care, and companies with responsive scheduling can book estimates or sign maintenance customers on the first call.

This product is suited to home services businesses with a team ready to answer during defined hours, a clear view of the consumer they want, and the capacity to convert a live conversation. The acquisition objective is simple: put your team in front of landscaping consumers at the moment they are deciding.
targetConsumer: Homeowners with yards who either lack the time or equipment for maintenance or are planning to invest in their outdoor space, concentrated in suburban single-family homes. The most valuable segments are homeowners seeking hardscape and outdoor living projects, new homeowners installing landscaping from scratch, and households looking for recurring maintenance contracts.
consumerIntent: Typical intent signals include: searching for landscaping companies near me, lawn care services or tree removal; recently purchased a home with an unfinished or neglected yard; planning a patio, retaining wall, outdoor kitchen or fire pit; storm damage to trees or drainage problems causing yard flooding.
howGenerated: Calls are generated through call-only and click-to-call performance campaigns targeting searches such as "landscaping companies near me" and "lawn care services near me", alongside social and comparison placements. Every source is tracked, so call quality can be traced back to the campaign that produced it.
qualification: Qualification is configured to your appetite. Standard landscaping criteria include: property located within the company's service area; homeowner or authorised decision maker for the property; type of service identified as maintenance, design and installation, hardscape, tree service or irrigation; approximate property size or project scope described; timeline for service or project start stated; interested in scheduling an estimate or recurring service.
delivery: Calls are routed to your sales line in real time by state or ZIP, schedule and agent availability, with concurrency limits and daily caps set to your capacity. Call tracking and recording are available for quality control.

process.title: PPC / Traffic Acquisition
process.text: Performance campaigns across search, social and comparison placements reach consumers actively looking for landscaping solutions.

process.title: Consumer Interest
process.text: The consumer sees a relevant landscaping offer with a prominent phone number and a clear reason to call.

process.title: Call Initiated
process.text: The consumer dials directly from the ad or landing page. Nobody is cold-called; the consumer chooses to reach out.

process.title: Qualification
process.text: Optional IVR prompts and duration thresholds screen out wrong numbers, non-prospects and out-of-area callers.

process.title: Inbound Call Delivered
process.text: The call rings your team in real time, routed by geography, schedule and agent availability.

faq.q: Can programs focus on hardscape and design projects rather than maintenance?
faq.a: Yes. Campaign messaging and screening can prioritise patios, retaining walls, outdoor living and landscape design, and maintenance inquiries can be limited or excluded.

faq.q: How do you handle seasonal demand?
faq.a: Volume can be scaled up in spring and summer and adjusted for fall cleanup and storm-driven tree work, with caps set to your crew capacity.

faq.q: Can tree service calls be delivered separately?
faq.a: Tree trimming and removal inquiries can be routed to a dedicated team or excluded entirely if you do not offer tree services.
